from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its own title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The paper's title as provided in the collection")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that this paper cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
